palette_description: Type to search surfaces, records and actions. Use arrow keys to move and Enter to open.
shortcuts_single_key_hint: Turning off single-key shortcuts disables ?, / and [. It also disables G sequences and Space on a table row. {mod}K and {escape} stay on.
shortcuts_focus_search: Focus the page search or filter
shortcuts_proceed: Proceed on the step on screen
shortcuts_go_to_step: Go to a step of the flow on screen
shortcuts_context_menu: Open the context menu of the focused row
shortcuts_close: Close a dialog, menu or panel
catalogue_datatable_description: The table sorts and filters rows. It supports presets, row selection and row expansion. It has batch actions and row actions. The batch bar replaces the toolbar row at the same height. Tab focuses the current row. Press Tab again to focus that row's controls.
catalogue_datatable_shift: Table shift on the last selection change: {px} px
catalogue_datatable_notes: Target is not sortable. If Camera text gets cut off, hover over it to read the full value.
catalogue_datatable_hover: Review rows highlight on hover. Confirmed rows without Review stay unchanged. Rows in the fixed-height table also stay unchanged.
catalogue_datatable_filter_bar_descripti: The same controlled filters for a list that is not a table.
catalogue_glyph_tips_desc: Two glyphs with a tooltip, kept apart by ADR-0002. Lock marks a protected item and names why. Its decorative mode is only for a reason stated once in nearby text. InfoTip carries help text shown nowhere else, so it has no decorative mode.
catalogue_glyph_tips_raw_frames_reason: PlateVault never moves or deletes raw frames.
catalogue_glyph_tips_rule: Each protected row needs your acknowledgement in the plan review.
catalogue_glyph_tips_tolerance_tip: A dark matches lights whose sensor temperature is within this many degrees.
home_no_site_yet: Add a site to see tonight's darkness and Moon.
home_add_captures_location: Add a Captures location to find new captures.
home_import_to_start: Import captures to start sorting them.
home_no_goals_suit_next: No goals suit tonight. Next good night: {date}.
session_adds_subject: Adds subject {name}, with the Project's goals
catalogue_f4_no_rigs_desc: What a rig picker shows when no rig is saved: where rigs are added, linked once Settings › Equipment is registered
project_target_not_added: PlateVault couldn't add {name} as a Target.
wrapup_offer_rejected_none: Move Unusable frames to Trash: none left
wrapup_offer_duplicates_none: Move duplicate copies to Trash: none left

match.countPlural=*: Add the Target again to restore its {count} hidden goals.

project_no_sessions: No sessions yet · pick from Suggestions
project_remove_session_summary: Removed from the View on next Apply. Files stay in place.
wrapup_offer_processing_none: No Processing files left to move to Trash.
wrapup_offer_view_none: No View entries left to move to Trash.
targets_preset_best_definition: Img time is above 0 and a broadband filter is ok tonight. The preset sorts by Img time, longest first.
targets_preset_narrowband_definition: With the Moon up, Img time is above 0 and at least one of Ha, SII or OIII is ok tonight.
targets_preset_emission_definition: Emission nebulae with Ha ok tonight.
targets_preset_galaxies_definition: Galaxies, Img time above zero, Moon down.
targets_preset_planetary_definition: Planetary nebulae with OIII ok tonight.
targets_preset_mosaic_definition: Targets needing 2 or more panels on a selected rig.
targets_preset_fits_definition: Targets that cover 25% to 90% of a selected rig's field.
targets_preset_needs_narrowband: Rig has no Ha, SII or OIII
targets_none_suitable: No targets match the selected filters.
targets_none_favourite: No target matches the Favourite filter
catalogue_grade_badges_desc: Display-only grade per filter for one night. Tone and icon indicate the grade.
catalogue_grade_badges_by_grade: One badge per grade, poor hidden (a table column)
targets_saved_no_narrowband: {name} has no Ha, SII or OIII filter
location_role_calibration_description: Darks, flats and bias. Masters too.

location_error_name_taken: Display name: {name} is already used by another location.
location_error_unknown_volume: Folder: {path} is not on a known volume.
location_retire_stale: Can't retire · {name} changed since this review
location_retire_availability_changed: Can't retire {name}. Availability changed from {then} to {now}.
location_remap_no_match: No frame in {name} has the same bytes in {path}
location_remap_unavailable: Remap not saved. Location or volume unavailable.

match.countPlural=*: Remap not saved. Hash check failed for {count} files on {volume}.

site_error_name_empty: Name: enter a name, for example Backyard.
site_error_name_taken: Name: {name} is already a saved site.
site_error_latitude: Latitude: enter degrees in the range -90°-90°. North is positive.
site_error_longitude: Longitude: enter degrees in the range -180°-180°. East is positive.
site_error_elevation: Elevation: enter metres as a number, or leave it empty.
site_error_min_altitude: Minimum altitude: enter degrees from 0 to 90.
site_error_time_zone_unknown: Time zone: {zone} is not an IANA time zone. Choose one from the list.
site_error_time_zone_empty: Time zone: choose the site's IANA time zone, for example Europe/Amsterdam.
settings_preference_unsaved: {reason} The change applies until PlateVault restarts.
location_unreadable_folders: Unreadable folders at the last scan
site_default_help: Reminders move to the default site.
settings_lookup_not_found: Couldn't find an object named {query} via {provider}.
settings_lookup_off: Online lookup is off · nothing sent
settings_lookup_query_empty: Enter a Target name or alias to look up, for example NGC 7000.
settings_lookup_online_help: Sends Target names to the provider. Indexing continues when a lookup fails.
setup_does_index: Indexes FITS and XISF folders in place
setup_does_sessions: Groups frames into sessions by filter, exposure and camera.
setup_does_coverage: Shows Target coverage and optional Project goals
setup_does_views: Prepares reviewed Views for your processing app
setup_never_move: Moves, renames or deletes files without a reviewed operation
setup_never_headers: Changes the headers of your source files
setup_never_account: Needs an account or a network connection
settings_keep_raws_help: When off, PlateVault moves raw calibration frames to the OS Trash after the matching master registers.
review_key_escape: Escape exits fullscreen. Press it again to clear the selection.
measure_all_have_value: Every readable frame has a built-in value.

importdlg_blocked_choose: Choose an export file to review its mapping.
importdlg_blocked_no_match: No row matches an indexed frame.

match.countPlural=*: {count} attach to no frame until reviewed

importdlg_note_stars: Shown next to built-in star count

op_interrupted_summary: Interrupted when PlateVault restarted. Retry continues from the recorded progress.
op_index_offline: Offline. PlateVault retains last-observed metadata and decisions.
op_index_went_offline: After {files}, the location went offline. PlateVault retains data from files it read.
op_index_access_denied: Access denied. Choose the folder again or Retry.

store_not_saved_message: {label} was not saved because the catalogue write failed. Your change is still on screen. Choose Retry to save it.

store_cal_raws_in_trash: raws already in the OS Trash

domain_preview_offline: Preview unavailable: the frame is offline.
domain_preview_unreadable: Preview unavailable: the frame is unreadable (access denied).
domain_preview_absent: Preview unavailable: the frame is not found at its last complete scan.
domain_naming_leading_slash: A template is relative to its location. Remove the leading /.
domain_naming_disallowed_characters: Remove {characters}. Between tokens, use alphanumeric characters and spaces, plus {separators}.
domain_naming_unmatched_brace: A brace has no partner: write each token in braces
op_trash_other_copy_refused: PlateVault refused to trash another copy: {reason}
op_trash_summary: Moved {trashed} to the OS Trash ({bytes}). Left {refused} in place with a reason. This operation permanently deleted nothing.
store_cal_suggestion_drifted: Can't use {path} for {session}: it changed or is missing.
store_catalog_only_detail: {name}. Catalogue only. Source headers are unchanged.
store_reason_no_confirmed_target: the session has no confirmed Target
store_reason_no_confirmed_rig: the session has no confirmed rig
store_goal_template_deleted_detail: Projects keep the values copied from it.
op_prep_not_reachable: No readable item at {path}. Nothing was written.
op_prep_source_changed: The source bytes differ from the catalogue fingerprint. Before preparing, rescan and review the source.
op_prep_destination_exists: Destination already exists at {path}. PlateVault did not overwrite it. Choose another destination.
op_prep_write_removed: Can't write to {folder}. Nothing was written.
op_prep_destination_offline: Destination volume for {folder} is not mounted.

plan_reason_lead_out_of_range: the lead time must be over 30 minutes and at most 7 days
plan_reminders_while_open: Reminders run only while PlateVault is open
plan_reminders_gathered_more: Windows open or coming up: {names} and {count} more
target_library_caption: Integration of {name} in the library, per channel
catalogue_app_frame_desc: The app window has a source list, toolbar, scrolling content pane and status bar. Setup uses SetupFrame.
catalogue_status_bar_desc: The bottom bar shows locations, selection, running work, issue counters and notifications. Each list is in a ListPopover.
catalogue_palette_desc: The command palette: places, records and registered Actions in one searchable list.
catalogue_walk_desc: The orientation walk uses a modal window. It cuts out each anchor and offers Back, Next and Skip. It skips a step with no anchor.
catalogue_dialogs_summary: Every dialog ends in DialogFooter, with Cancel first and one action after it. This order applies on every OS. The action is primary or red when destructive.
catalogue_dialogs_confirm_caption: When the action is destructive, focus starts on Cancel. Otherwise, focus starts on the action. Escape cancels and returns focus to the opening button. Tab to a group and press Enter or Space to unfold its files.
catalogue_dialogs_form_caption: Focus starts on the first field. Enter submits unless the action is destructive. Hover over or focus an unavailable action to see its reason.
catalogue_actions_summary: One Action renders in five places: a header button, named menu item, row ⋯ item, context-menu item and palette command. Each has the same label, shortcut and unavailable reason.
catalogue_actions_roles_caption: Role × size × state. Hover over, focus or press a button to show its hover, focus-visible and active states. Disabled buttons stay focusable.
catalogue_actions_button_caption: The kind picks the variant. In an xs table cell, a primary stays outline. Hover over or focus {archive} to see its blockers. {start} and {rescan} run slowly. The {remove} action returns a refusal. The second {rescan} fails and offers {retry}.
catalogue_actions_toggle_caption: Pressed while the state is on. A press runs the opposite action. A refusal shows beside the toggle.
catalogue_actions_quick_caption: One ticked action under each Quick actions mode. One-click runs it in place and offers Undo. Open page opens the page that owns it.
catalogue_actions_bar_caption: The bar shows up to 3 standard buttons, the named menu and one primary at the trailing end. A fourth standard action, destructive actions and overflow go in the menu ({more} by default or an object menu). Feedback shows under the bar.
catalogue_actions_menu_caption: Items arrive out of order, with {delete} first and doubled separators. Every menu puts {delete} last after one separator. Every menu also contains a heading group, submenu, shortcuts and an unavailable item with its reason. Right-click the box to open the same context menu.
catalogue_actions_menu_empty: No action: the menu renders nothing
catalogue_actions_rows_caption: Each row has a ⋯ in the Tab order. Right-click the row or ⋯, or press Shift+F10 or the Menu key, to open the same items. A single runner serves each list, so feedback shows under that list.
catalogue_feedback_refusal_desc: The refused control presents the reason beside it. The reason opens a hover card with blockers. Hover, focus or press to enter the card. Press Escape to close it. The refusal inserts nothing and moves nothing.
catalogue_feedback_action_error_desc: Shown under the field or beside the failed control, with an alert role.
catalogue_feedback_notice_slot_desc: One persistent page state appears under the header. It uses info, offline or warning tones. A null value renders nothing.
catalogue_feedback_toast_desc: The polite viewport region announces off-screen outcomes at the bottom trailing edge. A toast has at most one follow-up action and pauses on hover or focus.
catalogue_status_badge_desc: A glyph and word come from the STATUS registry. gate replaces GateLabel. profile, executable, check, write and preparation:unverified replace T4Badge.
catalogue_status_pill_desc: An inert tag (channel, band, kind): no link, no button, no hover. Tone text over its own tint.
catalogue_status_count_desc: A small number, capped at 99+, with an optional screen-reader label.
catalogue_status_badges_desc: Statuses of one object sit 8 px apart and wrap when the row runs out of room.
catalogue_page_desc: Templates use PageBody for a pane with 20 px margins and vertical rhythm. A Section uses an h2 with a one-line caption and actions beside the heading, or an h3 inside it.
catalogue_previews_blockers_desc: For a focusable disabled control, the card restates its description. Without a control, it renders the 'reason ▸' trigger for a Refusal. Press the trigger to move focus into the card.
catalogue_previews_blockable_desc: A control, such as an ActionButton, can become unavailable and return in place. One wrapper in both states keeps focus on the control.
catalogue_previews_blockers_body_desc: A preview card shows blockers as a list or a table with columns, followed by the actions that resolve them. A blocked ConfirmDialog presents the blockers in place.
catalogue_previews_used_by_desc: 'Used by N ▸' links to the full list. Hover or focus to preview the users.
catalogue_previews_master_compact: Compact: an icon link sits beside a picker. The picker displays the name, which the card uses as its title.
catalogue_previews_preview_desc: Preview is the shared L2 host for previews. HoverCard is the L1 primitive on the Base UI preview-card.
catalogue_fields_text_caption: When filled, a text field shows help. When empty, its error includes aria-invalid and the message. A field can use read-only mode or a disabled state. It can have an action beside the input.
catalogue_fields_choice_caption: An empty number field has an error and a unit. A select can disable one option or the whole control. A grouped combobox can be empty. A segmented control can disable one option.
catalogue_fields_switch_caption: Switches have on and disabled states. Folder, file (.fits, .xisf) and application modes each open the OS chooser. File mode also has an empty-field error and a disabled state.
catalogue_fields_template_caption: A valid template offers Omit, which leaves out the filter token. Its preview shows present and missing values. Unknown tokens and stray braces appear as inline errors, with no Omit option. Arguments accept valid templates and flag unknown tokens.
catalogue_fields_settings_caption: Fields placed directly in a SettingsSection render as rows, with a label column followed by the control. SettingsRow holds buttons and optional help.
catalogue_shell_nav_desc: The sidebar and Settings share one source list. A current row uses a selected fill and aria-current. A held row uses a leading bar and semibold text. Menu rows open a named menu beside the list. The collapsed rail shows tooltips and badge dots.
catalogue_shell_checklist_desc: The checklist sits in the sidebar footer, above Activity and Settings. It opens as a non-modal checklist at the named trigger. The page stays usable. Escape or an outside click closes it. An unavailable step shows its reason under the label.
catalogue_shell_theme_desc: Choose Light, Dark or Match system first. Then choose a theme for that mode. The choice applies to the whole app at once. The menu version is in the toolbar menu’s Theme submenu.
catalogue_shell_sidebar_recent: sidebar · recent Project open (Recent › Projects holds)
ds_color_primary: The one accent: primary action, selection, focus
ds_z_pinned_column: Pinned table column (under the sticky header row)
ds_z_flyouts: Non-modal flyouts anchored to the shell
ds_z_portalled: Portalled layers: dialog boxes, sheets, menus, popovers and tooltips (DOM order decides)
ds_filter_placeholder: Filter by channel, OBJECT or night
ds_empty_description: Filters change the list, not the selection. Clear them to see every session.
ds_op_location: Location to index (indexing never changes files)
ds_op_no_locations: This library has no locations. Register a location first.
ds_colour_description: Neutral base, one accent. Switch the theme from the header to check both.
ds_spacing: Spacing uses the Tailwind 4 px scale: control gap 2, card padding 4, page padding 6 × 5, section gap 6.
ds_row_height: Rows use --row-h (26 px). Row cells use --row-py for padding. The toolbar and batch bar use --toolbar-h.
ds_buttons_description: Buttons have six states: default, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading and toggle. Tab moves focus to a button. Disabled buttons display their reason. A pressed toggle displays a fill and an accent bar.

match.countPlural=one: Disabled: accept or resolve {count} calibration suggestion first.
match.countPlural=*: Disabled: accept or resolve {count} calibration suggestions first.

ds_loading_vs_disabled: Loading uses full opacity with a spinner and aria-busy. Disabled uses 50% opacity and shows its reason beside it.
ds_status_description: Every domain state: icon plus label, never colour alone.
ds_targets_empty_description: Targets appear when indexing finds pointing evidence. Index a capture location to begin.
ds_offline_body: {night} counts in captured integration with last-observed values. It is not offered as an available input.
ds_scan_incomplete_body: Access denied: {path}. The scan cannot determine whether files there exist.
ds_provisional_body: Indexing is still running. Totals cover captures from {volume} only.
ds_save_failed: PlateVault couldn't save the edit. It remains on screen.
ds_save_stale: This Project changed since you opened it (revision {from} → {to}).
ds_table_description: Sort and select rows. Each table uses one Tab stop on its current row. Use ↑/↓, Home/End and Page Up/Down to move between rows. Space selects a row and Enter opens it. The caller controls selection, which persists when filtering. Groups use header rows in one table, so columns line up across groups.
ds_confirm_description: Destructive or scope-changing actions always confirm in an AlertDialog that names the scope.

match.countPlural=one: Mark {count} included frame Usable in the library?
match.countPlural=*: Mark {count} included frames Usable in the library?

ds_folder_picker_description: Chooses a folder, a file or an application on a sample disk. Choosing never writes anything.
ds_operation_description: Running with progress, per-item outcomes and one settled status, on a sample indexing run.
domain_calibration_source_missing: The library has no source file
domain_calibration_version_drifted: The file differs from its indexed version
domain_calibration_version_drifted_adopt: The file differs from the version in the library
domain_calibration_version_unverified: PlateVault cannot verify {path}: it cannot read the file now
catalogue_pickers_site_missing: No saved site matches the selection
catalogue_pickers_night_desc: ‹ › changes the selected night. weekStep changes it by a week. The date opens a calendar. Keyboard navigation: Arrow keys move by day or week; Page Up and Page Down move by month. The current-date button stays in place. PlateVault disables it for tonight. Every night has a value; empty, loading and error states do not apply.
catalogue_pickers_site_desc: Saved sites mark the default. Manage sites… opens site management. Without a saved site, one Add site button appears. If the selected site is not saved, the control reads Choose a site. The local list has no loading state.
catalogue_pickers_location_desc: The fields store the location, and the marker follows them. Click the map or drag the marker to update the fields. When typing pauses for 1 s, location search sends at most 1 request per second and shows Searching. Use my location fills the fields on success. On failure, the control gives a reason. If the device is offline or map tiles or search fail, Map unavailable replaces the map and search.
catalogue_pickers_target_desc: Results by source: My targets, catalogues, SIMBAD. Choosing one runs its primary action and clears the input. The SIMBAD state and a missing match read under the field.
catalogue_pickers_display_desc: The named menu contains radio groups, check groups and a column choice. Check groups leave the menu open. The required column stays checked. With no groups, nothing renders.
catalogue_domain_plate_desc: The host controls the view, so both plates share zoom and centre. The wheel zooms at the pointer. Click Fit to zoom to 1:1 at that point. Use + or - on the keyboard to change zoom. When zoomed, drag or use the arrow keys to pan. The Display menu sets zoom, stretch and the star overlay.
catalogue_domain_histogram_desc: Linear data for the region shown. The line marks the median sky background.
catalogue_domain_night_desc: One night at one site, in the site's time zone. The sparkline's tooltip and accessible name state the same facts.
catalogue_domain_calendar_desc: Upcoming nights appear one week per row at each site. Rows start Monday in en-GB and Sunday in pt-BR. Each night links to a Preview card. The card opens on hover or keyboard focus. It stays open while hovered and closes with Escape. The card has no controls and takes no focus. The calendar uses one Tab stop. Arrow keys move by night or week. Home and End move to the week’s first or last night. Past nights show only their date.
catalogue_domain_calendar_filled: Calendar with 30 nights. Some nights suit no goal. Others have no plan.
catalogue_domain_map_desc: OpenStreetMap tiles load in a lazy chunk. The marker follows the fields. Click or drag the marker to report a position.
catalogue_domain_review_desc: Review visuals: the corner tiles, the frame thumbnails as a strip and a grid, the session plots and a star's cutouts.
catalogue_workspace_desc: The review workspace fills the full height. It has a toolbar and a list. It also has a stage, inspector and status line.
flow_reason_whole_days: Enter a whole number of days
catalogue_stepflow_desc: Each staged flow uses one strip and one footer. The strip marks the current step. The footer holds one primary action: Proceed, or the flow’s own verb on the last step.
catalogue_stepflow_states_caption: Fixed flows with plain-text steps. The footer belongs to the step on screen, underlined in the strip.
catalogue_stepflow_wrapup_caption: Steps are local buttons. Proceed with nothing selected skips the step. Later steps stay read-only until earlier steps finish or the user skips them. An earlier step remains available until Close project.
catalogue_stepflow_review_caption: Steps are links. Finish review opens the next session that needs review. After the last session, the page becomes read-only.
catalogue_stepflow_dialog_caption: Steps are local buttons. Proceed opens the next step in the same dialog. Import closes the dialog on the last step. To revisit an earlier step, select it. Later steps allow read-only access.
catalogue_templates_list_desc: A list page has one primary action, three standard actions and the rest under the object menu. Only the table frame scrolls. At 1400 px wide or more, a row opens its details beside the table. Below 1400 px, they open under it.
catalogue_templates_list_shift: Layout shift on the last selection or row change: {px} px
catalogue_templates_no_seed: Example content is unavailable for this view.
catalogue_templates_detail_desc: Detail page: path, title and status. It also has an object menu, view tabs and a column of boxes. A session row opens its details in the same dock as on a list page.
catalogue_templates_detail_aside_desc: A detail page with an aside uses two columns from 1280 px wide: sections in one column and the aside in the other. Below 1280 px, the sections and aside stack in one column, with sections first.
catalogue_templates_step_desc: Step page: the step strip sits under the header, with one step region and a footer. Proceed stays fixed at the bottom. Earlier and later steps open read-only. Changing step moves nothing.
catalogue_templates_step_shift: Layout shift on the last step change: {px} px
catalogue_templates_settings_desc: A Settings area: its title, setting rows, and a list section with one Add in its heading.
catalogue_feedback_save_state_desc: A settings section shows its save state beside the heading. A committed write shows Saved. A failed write shows Not saved with Retry, which repeats the write. Another change shows Changed elsewhere. Before the first save, no state appears.
help_tip_auto_advance_value: P, X or U moves on to the next frame.
help_tip_pan_value: Drag or use the arrow keys. Shift pans further.
help_tip_threshold_value: Click a plot to set the threshold. Selecting frames never changes their quality.
help_tip_duplicates_value: PlateVault scans library locations for duplicate files, not capture cards. It keeps the copy at the location it registered first.
help_tip_default_site_value: Plan and Planning use the selected site by default. Choose another site to change it. Reminders follow the selected site.
help_tip_site_headers_value: No saved site covers SITELAT or SITELONG.
settings_keyword_invalid: {name}: use letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter
settings_keyword_reserved: {name} is already a View folder keyword
settings_matching_flat_rotation_order: The fine flat rotation is above the warning level
settings_matching_panel_overlap_order: The lowest panel overlap is above the highest
settings_rig_version_after: A new version starts after {night}, when the current one began

match.countPlural=*: Moving {n} copies to the OS Trash

duplicates_none_movable: Every frame keeps a copy that can't go
apps_refused_name_taken: Another application already has the name {name}
apps_refused_launch_taken: {name} already uses this path with these arguments
calibration_process_missing_title: This process is not in the catalogue
calibration_import_no_files: No master files in this folder
catalogue_templates_list_path_desc: A list page inside an object: the path names its parents, the way a Project's sessions read Projects › the Project › Sessions. Only the title names the window tab.
catalogue_datatable_columns_description: The Columns menu hides 3 columns. Two start hidden. The row header and row actions stay visible, so the menu omits them. The column choice persists across reloads.
catalogue_fields_segmented_narrow: narrow box: options wrap inside onto line 2
catalogue_fields_notes_sample: Imaged from the back garden. Flats captured at dusk.
catalogue_fields_group_caption: Example: 2 goals. Each group has a named Remove action. An hours-or-frames error appears with the control disabled.
catalogue_fields_cell_caption: Cell mode (hideLabel): the label names the control for screen readers only. The row keeps its height.
project_all_rigs_added: All rigs are in the Project
project_apply_readd_view: The folder layout changes: re-add View in your tool after Apply.
project_apply_space_two_views: {size} · room for two full Views while it runs
project_apply_waiting: Waiting for a tool to release a file in View
project_group_missing: a group missing from the Project
project_output_adopt_own_copy_title: Move PlateVault's copy at the destination to the Trash and add again?
project_output_offline: The Output folder's volume isn't connected
project_pin_unreadable: PlateVault cannot read the {kind} file now
project_reason_fix_at_source: fix it at its source, or remove the session
project_reason_folder_fixed: The Project folder is fixed at {path} since the first Apply
import_split_help: A frame starts another session if it exceeds either limit from the session's first frame. These limits apply only to this import.
help_tip_marks_library: P, X and U set the library mark for every Project. Open Projects show it as a pending change. Closed Projects keep their snapshot.
catalogue_f4_duplicates_desc: A session-row badge for byte-identical extra frame copies found by the latest scan.
catalogue_f4_readiness_desc: A session's intake status on every session row: Ready or the next step. A reopened review can return a held session to Unreviewed, shown as Needs review in its Projects.
catalogue_f4_readiness_states: Ready · needs a Target · needs a rig · 1 frame unreviewed · Trashed
catalogue_f4_master_age_desc: The Old badge on a Calibration library master row: a dark or bias master captured longer ago than the age limit in Settings › Matching.
naming_keyword_group_help: WBPP groups frames by this folder prefix, as in {keyword}_<group name>
naming_keyword_panel_help: WBPP groups mosaic panels by this folder prefix, as in {keyword}_<panel name>
catalogue_fields_choice_list_caption: Multiple selected with help · none selected with an error · options disabled · field disabled · no options
catalogue_fields_token_table_caption: Template field without its own token table, followed by TokenTable with Omit.
catalogue_goal_fields_desc: C7 goal fields: goals count time or frames and may include an FWHM bar. The per-channel template editor.
catalogue_goal_fields_channels: limited to the rig set's channels
catalogue_primitives_alert_body: Indexed sessions stay listed. The next scan continues with the rest of the drive.
catalogue_primitives_alert_box_body: Indexing reads files. Move or delete files in Wrap up.
catalogue_primitives_alert_box_desc: The box behind Notice and PageNotice: an icon, a title and one line.
catalogue_primitives_alert_box_offline: Astro-T7 is offline. Its 12 sessions remain listed.
catalogue_primitives_alert_desc: ConfirmDialog is a modal for decisions. It takes focus and stays open after an outside click. The footer puts Cancel first and the action last.
catalogue_primitives_announcer_desc: The shell mounts one polite live region. announce() sends status updates through it, even while a dialog is open.
catalogue_primitives_badge_desc: Pill and StatusBadge use this base component.
catalogue_primitives_breadcrumb_desc: The path above a level-2 page title: each step is a link, the current page is plain text.
catalogue_primitives_checkbox_desc: A 16 px box with a 24 px target. CheckboxGroup stores the values; ChoiceListField renders it.
catalogue_primitives_clearable_desc: Search and filter fields clear with × or Escape when filled. Search also shows a magnifier and uses / as a shortcut.
catalogue_primitives_collapsible_body: Registered, calibrated and integrated frames: 1.2 GB in the work folder.
catalogue_primitives_collapsible_desc: Hides a block below its trigger. ConfirmDialog uses it to collapse file groups.
catalogue_primitives_combobox_desc: Choose from a long or grouped list, filtered as you type. ComboboxField and the pickers use it; ComboboxEmpty appears when nothing matches.
catalogue_primitives_context_area: Right-click here, or focus it and press Shift+F10
catalogue_primitives_context_desc: Open RowContextMenu with right-click, Shift+F10, the Menu key or a long press. Each item is also available outside the menu.
catalogue_primitives_dialog_body: M 31 · 2026-09-14 · 42 lights of 300 s through the L filter.
catalogue_primitives_dialog_desc: FormDialog is a modal in three widths. Close it with the corner button, Escape or an outside click. Cancel in the footer closes it.
catalogue_primitives_dropdown_desc: ActionMenu, RowActions, DisplayMenu and filter facets use this menu for checkboxes, radio options, submenus, shortcuts and destructive actions.
catalogue_primitives_empty_body: Import a night's captures to start.
catalogue_primitives_empty_desc: The layout behind EmptyState: icon, one line, one action.
catalogue_primitives_help_body: Archived sessions keep their raw frames. Intermediate files go to Trash.
catalogue_primitives_input_desc: L2 fields use text controls. FieldLabel names each control; FieldError states the problem below it and links it with aria-describedby.
catalogue_primitives_input_group_desc: An input with a leading icon and trailing button inside its border. ComboboxInput and the command palette use it.
catalogue_primitives_kbd_desc: A keycap shows shortcuts in menus, tooltips and Help. KbdGroup groups keys in a chord.
catalogue_primitives_list_detail_desc: A list pane beside a detail pane, as Settings uses it: the list keeps 18rem, and below 768 px the panes stack.
catalogue_primitives_operation_desc: Each operation uses one line for its title, status, progress or settled time, and controls.
catalogue_primitives_popover_body: Exclude nights when the Moon is above 30° and more than 60% lit.
catalogue_primitives_popover_desc: A non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, for a short setting or a picker. Escape and an outside click close it and return focus to the trigger.
catalogue_primitives_progress_desc: The bar shows a label and value, or runs indeterminately without one. MiniProgress and operation lines use it.
catalogue_primitives_radio_desc: One choice from a few options that all stay visible.
catalogue_primitives_sample_notes: Thin cloud after 01:00. Later frames were rejected.
catalogue_primitives_select_desc: SelectSeparator separates a final option, such as All or Manage…, from the list above. See Fields for the other Select parts.
catalogue_primitives_separator_desc: Separator divides a toolbar or list. Skeleton holds a region's shape while it loads.
catalogue_primitives_sheet_body: Escape or the close button returns focus to the control that opened the sheet.
catalogue_primitives_sheet_desc: Use Sheet for the narrow-window navigation drawer. Show page details in DetailDock.
catalogue_primitives_switch_desc: An on/off setting that applies immediately in three sizes. Use lg for the 24 px target in dense lists.
catalogue_primitives_tabs_desc: ViewTabs shows different views of one record. Disabled tabs remain visible.
catalogue_primitives_tips_desc: HelpTip (ⓘ) explains a non-obvious rule. A page has at most one. NoteMarker (①) shows a measurement's method, basis and time.
catalogue_primitives_tooltip_desc: Names an icon-only control and shows its shortcut. Put lists and readouts in a HoverCard. TooltipProvider sets the shared delay.

apply_refused_changed: The Project changed since this opened: review the latest changes
apply_refused_developer_mode: Symlinks need Developer Mode on Windows

shortcuts_select_row: Select or clear the focused row

catalogue_previews_master_version_desc: A master version's name links to its master in the Calibration library. Hover or focus to preview its settings, version, night, frames, origin, age and Projects using it.
catalogue_previews_master_newer: newer of two versions, stacked, used by 2 Projects
catalogue_previews_master_old_only: one version, past the age limit, unused
catalogue_domain_mosaic_map_desc: Read-only map of each panel group's median pointing and rotation, north up and east left. A dot marks each session. Amber means it is outside its panel. The list names all panels.
catalogue_domain_mosaic_outside: 2 × 2, a session outside its panel, a panel with no pointing
catalogue_domain_mosaic_fov_unknown: field of view unknown: list only
catalogue_f4_error_message: The sample couldn't be read. Retry to load it again.
catalogue_f4_diagram_desc: Read-only calibration diagram of a Project. It shows each group's night folders and light sets with their flats, darks and bias, plus versions and evidence. It also shows No choices, changed pins and mixed dark or bias versions. Names link to sessions or the library.
catalogue_f4_diagram_what_if: what-if: mixed dark versions, a second flat set, a suggestion, No bias, a changed flat
catalogue_f4_choices_desc: Set each session's calibration by kind with Confirm, Choose ▸, No or Add files. Open a row for evidence or press Shift+F10 for its menu.
catalogue_f4_choices_read_only: not changeable: a suggestion, No bias, a changed flat
catalogue_f4_tree_desc: The View that Apply will build, as shown in the Apply sheet. Use ↑/↓ to move, → to open, ← to close, and Home/End to jump.
catalogue_f4_tree_mixed: what-if, Copies: darks in the nights, NIGHT_…-2
calibration_old_after_help: Age checks apply to darks and bias, not flats
store_cal_camera_needed: The rigs hold {cameras} {model} cameras. Choose which camera this master came from.
calibration_trash_copy_and_add: Move copy to Trash and add

view_note_siril_links: The sets are symlinks in either input mode.
